items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: And that's how I got in Lunceford's band.

ctx.x: We could get in the band and the brass would take over a couple of choruses. And that's how I got in Lunceford's band. He was playing the Parlor, and I went down and heard the band, I thought the band was fantastic, it was a show band.
